label: Full refund
description: Resolve entirely in the customer's favour and return the full disputed amount.

label: Partial refund
description: Return part of the disputed amount, typically where fault is shared or goods were partly usable.

label: Replacement or store credit
description: Make the customer whole without a cash refund, via replacement shipment or account credit.

label: Request more evidence
description: The claim is plausible but unproven. Ask the customer for a specific missing artefact before deciding.

label: Reject claim
description: Evidence or policy does not support the dispute. Decline and explain why.

label: Escalate to human review
description: Confidence is low, policies conflict, or the case carries legal, fraud or regulatory risk.
